lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of approximately 4-5 semi-regular vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, extending posteriorly along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal alignment of circular high-luminance blobs to form a distinct grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixels on the superior aspect and darker shadow pixels on the inferior aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 discernible high-luminance blobs, primarily distributed in the posterior region of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-frequency distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, contrasting with the lower-frequency, larger-diameter spot distribution on the lateral flank.
